book_id.description: The book's ReadingRate id or its library entry id

current_page.description: The page the reader is now on, as printed in arabic numerals

front_matter_ends_on.description: The last roman-numbered page of the reader's copy, such as "lx" (or 60); "0" when it has none or they skipped it

notes.description: The reader's note on today's reading, added to today's journal entry

pages_read.description: Pages read in this session, added to the current page

roman_page.description: The page the reader is now on in the book's roman-numbered introduction or preface, such as "liv"

name: log_reading_session

book.description: The book: id, slug, title, authors

estimate.description: hours_remaining and description; null when the total pages are unknown

progress.description: current_page (the stored position, counted from page i when the copy has roman front matter), page_label (the page as the book prints it, e.g. "liv" or "10"), front_matter_pages, total_pages (printed pages of the reader's copy, without a roman introduction: show page_label of total_pages), percent_complete and pages_remaining (over the whole copy)

status_changed.description: Set when the book moved from want-to-read to reading

velocity_used.description: Pages per hour used for the estimate

title: Log a reading session
